'''Armala''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Republic soldier]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed on the Republic's [[Carrick Station]], where he built armor in a small shop.

==Behind the scenes==
Armala appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released in [[2011]], as the Armormech Crew Skill Trainer on Carrick Station.<ref name="TOR" />
